Draw the architecture diagram for the model in this YAML spec as a single standalone SVG file,
following the system instructions exactly.

Before writing, check:
- the layer counts in compressed_view add up to 52
- every zoom panel in the spec has its own data-zoom group
- every callout appears in its own data-callout group, worded exactly as written
- every element is at least 24 px inside the canvas, and nothing overlaps

SPEC:
# Diagram spec: Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K
# Generated by archwatch.diagram_spec from the published, verifier-approved fields of
# nvidia/Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K at commit 94ea861e00. No value here comes from an LLM.
# The diagram must use ONLY what is written here. If something is not here, leave it out.

model:
  name: Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K
  title_label: Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K
  total_params: 8.10B
  layers: 52
  hidden_size: 4096
  vocabulary: 131,072 (128K)
  context_length: 8K tokens (8,192)
layer_pattern:
  summary: 24 Mamba-2 + 24 MLP + 4 GQA layers
  compressed_view:
  - repeat: 2
    layers:
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    note: layers 1-4
  - repeat: 4
    layers:
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    - Mamba-2
    - GQA
    - MLP
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    note: layers 5-48
  - repeat: 2
    layers:
    - Mamba-2
    - MLP
    note: layers 49-52
decoder_layer:
- norm
- 'operator: Mamba-2, MLP, GQA (see zoom panels)'
- residual add
zoom_panels:
  mamba2:
    title: Mamba-2 (24 layers)
    parts:
    - 'in_proj: Linear 4096 -> 18560, split into z (8192), x (8192), B and C (8 groups x 128 each) and dt (128)'
    - depthwise Conv1d (kernel 4) on x, B and C (10240 channels)
    - 'selective state-space scan: 128 heads x 64 dims, state size 128; cache does not grow with context'
    - norm (8192) gated by z
    - 'out_proj: Linear 8192 -> 4096'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  mlp:
    title: MLP (24 layers)
    parts:
    - 'up projection: Linear 4096 -> 21504; squared ReLU'
    - 'down: Linear 21504 -> 4096'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  gqa:
    title: GQA attention (4 layers)
    parts:
    - 32 query heads, 8 key/value heads, head size 128
    - 'q: Linear 4096 -> 4096; k and v: Linear 4096 -> 1024 each'
    - 'output projection: Linear 4096 -> 4096'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
io:
  bottom:
  - Tokenized text
  - Token embedding 131,072 x 4096
  top:
  - Final norm
  - LM head 4096 -> 131,072 (not tied to the embedding)
callouts:
- 'Context length: 8K tokens'
- 24 Mamba-2 + 24 MLP + 4 GQA
- 32 Q / 8 KV heads
- 'Vocabulary: 128K'
- 'KV cache: 16 KB per token (only the 4 GQA layers grow)'
do_not_include:
- any benchmark scores
- any number not in this file
- logos or watermarks
- any position-encoding label (none is published for this model)
